# frontier-wire

> An openly automated, bilingual (RU + EN) news wire covering AI, tech, science, world, culture and economy.
> Written twice a day by a scheduled agent from real, cited sources. Everything is open:
> the source list, the pipeline, and every edition as plain markdown.

Publisher: Danila Katalshov — https://adanman.github.io

## Machine-friendly entry points
- RSS feed: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/feed.xml
- JSON Feed (with raw-markdown pointers): https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/feed.json
- Latest edition, plain markdown index: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/latest.md
- Sitemap: https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/sitemap.xml
- Raw markdown of every article: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/editions/<YYYY>/<MM-DD>/<NN-slug>.md
- Source list (RSS feeds we read): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/feeds.txt
- Edition format spec: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire/main/FORMAT.md
- Repository: https://github.com/ADanMan/frontier-wire

## Latest articles
- [Kimi K3.1 Pro reaches Moonshot services, with weights promised by November 4](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-24/01-kimi-k31-pro-api-release.html) — The announcement separates service access from a future weight release, with benchmark results attributed to the developer.
- [A PyTorch 2.15 MPS review traces performance and memory bottlenecks on Macs](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-24/02-pytorch-mps-memory-kernels.html) — Hugging Face's team details FP8, specialised Metal kernels and a video-decoding driver-memory fix.
- [Swift ends science observations after nearly 22 years](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-24/03-swift-science-mission-ends.html) — The final observation occurred on October 20; atmospheric re-entry is still expected, while the archive remains available.
- [Two-colour glow helps separate plant gene activity from physiological background](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-24/04-two-colour-plant-reporters.html) — MRC researchers use a signal ratio as an internal reference while observing defence responses near infection sites.
- [NASA revises lunar-landing architectures and Artemis III testing plans](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-24/05-artemis-lander-architecture.html) — Two providers are preparing different routes, with 2027 docking tests intended to precede landings targeted for 2028.
- [FairStress tests whether model decisions stay equally robust when demographic signals change](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-21/01-fairstress-decision-robustness.html) — Ai2's new benchmark examines final choices and responses to matched persuasion favouring different candidates.
- [Hugging Face details native Google TPU support through TorchTPU](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-21/02-torchtpu-hugging-face.html) — The backend preserves PyTorch interfaces, while reported test coverage and kernel speedups need their own context.
- [NASA tests a thin airfoil for future Mars helicopters](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-21/03-mars-helicopter-airfoil.html) — Simulations and wind-tunnel tests show promise for roamx-0201, while an 18.7-kilometre range remains a projection.
- [NASA details testing milestones for VIPER and crewed lunar rovers](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-21/04-lunar-rover-testing-update.html) — The update distinguishes a built rover in final testing, crew-evaluation mockups and future lunar deliveries.
- [NASA assigns work on the SR-1 Freedom power module](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-21/05-sr1-power-module-contracts.html) — The contract actions concern heat-to-electricity conversion; the nuclear-electric propulsion demonstration remains planned for 2028.
- [TorchNeuron brings familiar PyTorch interfaces to Trainium](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-20/01-torchneuron-native-pytorch.html) — The public beta is dated October 20, while code compatibility and workload performance remain separate questions.
- [NASA refines a water-storage map and its links to human activity](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-20/02-grace-human-water-storage.html) — The new feature examines 2002–2025 trends, gaining spatial detail at the expense of temporal resolution.
- [NASA standardises shock and vibration modelling before launch](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-20/03-nasa-shock-vibration-workflow.html) — Kennedy engineers use a finite-element template to examine flight and transport environments independently.
- [Juvenile striped bass surveys show different conditions across Chesapeake Bay](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-20/04-chesapeake-juvenile-striped-bass.html) — Virginia reports an average 2026 year class; Maryland's index improved but remained below its own long-term average.
- [NASTIC protein-tracking platform moves into commercial research](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-20/05-nastic-accretion-bio.html) — The University of Queensland announces Accretion Bio, an early drug-discovery venture rather than a new treatment.
- [A Sanam temple workshop reveals royal craft production in Kush](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-19/01-sanam-faience-workshop.html) — The study connects faience-production remains with royal authority, while cautioning against generalizing from one workshop.
- [Two LLM updates address a Datasette dependency and simulated token accounting](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-19/02-llm-plugin-dependency-and-echo-fixes.html) — The llm-tools-datasette fix and llm-echo release address separate compatibility and debugging tasks.
- [NASA publishes an autumn view of Bieszczady forests and mountain meadows](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-19/03-bieszczady-landsat-autumn.html) — The October 19 image of the day was captured by Landsat 9 on October 8, documenting a landscape rather than a new climate record.
- [Beam arrives with Apache 2.0 and recipes for serving and adapting a large model](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-19/04-beam-open-model-recipes.html) — The October 16 announcement describes 501 billion parameters and integrations, while explicitly separating small demonstrations from benchmarks.
- [NASA details its MMX contribution ahead of the planned Mars-moon mission launch](https://adanman.github.io/frontier-wire/e/2026-10-16/01-mmx-nasa-launch-preparations.html) — JAXA plans to study Phobos and Deimos and return samples; launch and sample delivery remain ahead.
